summary: Ingress assertion id rewrite strips tenant suffix, suppresses role bindings, causing 403s for service accounts
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports that service accounts intermittently receive 403 Authorization failures when calling Redwood Private Admin API. The root cause appears tied to an ingress-side transformation that rewrites SAML/OIDC assertion IDs and in the process strips a tenant suffix from assertion subject strings. Impact: Multiple Helios scheduled workers and CI runners fail to perform admin impersonation and token refresh, resulting in job failures and support-facing alerts. Scope: Affects only Helios' private deployment in eu-west where they have a custom ingress filter chain that performs assertion-id rewrites for legacy proxies.

Observed behavior:
- Service account tokens are accepted by IdP but when exchanged at Redwood's private control plane result in 403s.
- Audit logs show subject identifiers without tenant suffix ("@helios" removed) which mismatch tenant-scoped RBAC bindings.
- Failures started after an ingress upgrade (edge-proxy v2.18) deployed 2026-03-09.

Expected behavior:
- Assertion subject IDs forwarded intact, tenant suffix preserved, role lookup succeeds and requests are authorized.

Key customer impact: Scheduled pipeline jobs and on-prem connectors unable to perform admin operations; elevated support urgency and potential SLA impact.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use a service account in Helios tenant with scoped role bindings (service:ci-runner).
2) Trigger an admin API call that requires impersonation (POST /admin/impersonate).
3) Observe 403 response and check control-plane auth audit for the subject claim value.
4) Compare assertion subject before/after ingress filter using a duplicated request that bypasses rewrite (when possible).
logs: 2026-03-09T22:11:04Z WARN auth: subject mismatch: received 'ci-runner@helios' -> forwarded 'ci-runner'
2026-03-09T22:11:04Z ERROR admin-api: authorization denied tenant_id=helios, subject=ci-runner, roles=[]
IdP exchange trace: id_token.sub=ci-runner@helios (original) -> forwarded_subject=ci-runner (after ingress rewrite)
investigation_notes: 03/10 09:15 CET - Confirmed failures correlate with edge-proxy v2.18 rollout across eu-west ingress nodes.
03/10 10:02 CET - Captured packet dump at ingress showing header 'x-assertion-subject: ci-runner' (tenant suffix removed) after rewrite filter.
03/10 11:40 CET - Verified SCIM provisioning still lists service-account principal as 'ci-runner@helios' in customer directory; mismatch occurs after our ingress.
03/11 08:20 CET - Hypothesis: ingress rewrite code treats '@' as a delimiter and strips domain portion when assertion id contains no expected namespace header.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:20 - Aisha Khan: Initial triage: escalated to Infra team and requested ingress rollout timestamps from customer. Asked Helios to hold additional rollouts.
2026-03-10 10:30 - Marco Rivera: Reproduced locally by deploying edge-proxy v2.18 with default rewrite filter. Confirmed subject suffix drop when tenant-namespace header absent.
2026-03-10 14:05 - Helios Support (Liam O'Connor): We pushed an emergency config to disable rewrite on one node; that node's requests succeed. Full fleet still impacted.
2026-03-11 09:00 - Marco Rivera: Created PR to add tenant-suffix-preserve flag to rewrite filter (github.com/redwood/ingress-fixes/pull/314). Added unit tests for assertion strings containing '@'.
2026-03-12 07:45 - Aisha Khan: Customer confirmed workaround (disable rewrite) reduced failure rate to 0% on test namespace. Scheduling rolling patch deployment with Infra.
resolution: Workaround: Instructed Helios to disable the assertion-id rewrite filter on all ingress nodes (config toggle). Patch: merged PR to ingress repo that preserves tenant suffix and guards on missing namespace headers. Rollout: hotfix scheduled and applied to eu-west on 2026-03-12 04:30 UTC. Post-deploy verification showed RBAC lookups succeed and 403s resolved. Follow-up: add integration test to prevent future regressions and update runbook to include rollback steps for rewrite filter.
postmortem_next_steps: 1) Add automated Canary test that asserts assertion subject round-trip through ingress preserves tenant suffix.
2) Update ingress filter config docs with tenant-suffix-preserve flag and example for private deployments.
3) Schedule a retro with Helios infra team to review deployment gating and config drift policies.
4) Monitor audit logs for 72 hours for re-occurrence and alert on subject-role mismatch rate > 0.1%
